verdict.rationale: Zoom's first-party docs describe a diarization option that identifies speakers and adds a speaker label to transcript segments. The synchronous transcribe endpoint documents diarization as a request control, and its JSON response includes transcript segments with speaker labels and timing fields. Channel separation is also offered as a stereo alternative. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of diarization accuracy, explicit documentation of diarization support in Live and Batch modes.
